en.headline: Police arrest mainland driver in cross-border unlicensed taxi sting
en.dek: Island District officers posed as passengers for a Wong Chuk Hang to Guangzhou service priced at 1,500 yuan and detained a 42-year-old two-way permit holder on three charges.
body: Police arrested a 42-year-old mainland man on Saturday after officers posed as passengers for an unlicensed cross-border car service. Island District Traffic Division officers booked a trip from Wong Chuk Hang to Guangzhou via social media, with the intermediary quoting 1,500 yuan.

A locally registered private car with dual Hong Kong-mainland plates arrived to collect the undercover officers. Once the journey began, officers identified themselves and arrested the driver, who holds a two-way permit. He was charged with using a vehicle for illegal hire or reward, driving without third-party insurance, and violating conditions of stay. The car was towed for inspection.

Senior Inspector Yim Sze-ho of the Island District Traffic Division said the operation targeted unlicensed cross-border services advertised online. Police reminded the public to use only licensed public transport, noting that unlicensed vehicles may lack valid insurance, leaving passengers and others unprotected in an accident. First-time offenders face up to a HK$10,000 fine and six months in prison, with licence disqualification of at least 12 months.

zh.headline: 警放蛇打擊跨境白牌車 拘42歲雙程證內地司機
zh.dek: 港島總區交通部警員喬裝乘客，預約由黃竹坑前往廣州的服務，中介開價人民幣1500元，成功拕捕一名42歲持雙程證男子，涉三項罪名。
body: 警方星期六採取行動打擊跨境非法載客取酬，拕捕一名42歲內地男子。港島總區交通部執行及管制組人員透過社交媒體預約由黃竹坑前往廣州的載客服務，中介索價人民幣1500元，並派出一輚本地登記、掛有中港牌的私家車接載。
喬裝乘客的警員登車後表露身份，拕捕該名持雙程證的司機，涉嫌利用汽車作非法出租或載客取酬用途、沒有第三者保險而使用車輚，以及違反逗留條件。涉案私家車已被拖走扣留作進一步檢驗。
港島總區交通部高級督察嚴思浩表示，行動針對網上招攬的跨境白牌車服務。警方提醒市民選擇合法公共交通工具，因非法載客車輚的第三者保險可能失效，一旦發生意外，乘客及其他道路使用者將失去保障。首次定罪最高可處罰款1萬元及監禁6個月，司機亦會被取消駕駛資格至少12個月。
